reviews.review:
All in all Immortal Unchained isn't a bad game and you can certainly have fun with it. It does however have to many downsides that make me not recommend it.

Areas are way too large. I'd much rather have smaller areas that are more visually unique.
Snipers are OP if you don't suck at aiming. Most enemies were one-hit and bosses usually lost 10% to 20% per hit.
Bosses all feel kind of the same to the degree that they do not have tactics that stood out too me (except the tree boss).

If this game would've come out somewhere between 2010 and 2015 it would've been received better and could've stood among games that have similar mechanics as a decent enough game to try out, but in 2018 that is not the case and you can find better.

Immortal Unchained is a very interesting and playable souls-like game with fire weapons.
I am not sure what bugs did this have at launch, but I dont think it's a buggy game at all at its current state.
Yes, it's a difficult game, but you really feel the learning curve working on your favour. It's fun and I like how it plays.
I recommend this game, particularly if you're a Dark Souls and Remnant From the Ashes fan

Edit edit:  I played it a bit further. I was right the first time. This game is awful.  It is one of those games where it sucks you in, makes you think it's accessible, then slams you into a wall and unless you are some kind of prodigy, you are going to have to grind for HOURS to level up just so you are not constantly one shotted by teleporting snipers in the third area. The sort of game that you only keep playing out of spite for the time you already invested. ♥♥♥♥ this game. Not for dollar, not for free even. It is not worth your time. Nor was completing it properly worth the Devs time. But apparently passive aggressive snarky replies to negative reviews is worth their time.  I hope they consider developing Immortal a bit further... Here's to hope.

Edit: I got triggered. I blame gluten. (really Monsanto but that is another story) I continued playing because there was something intriguing about the atmosphere and I decided to change my vote, also the Dev was kind enough to take my piss with general aplomb and I can respect that. So I found the linear game play and limited grind of it to be reasonably fun for the discount price. I am going to leave my original review though...with some *(notes)*...

Game deserves IMMEDIATE down vote. *(if you are a dumb spaz like me)*  Very first interaction in the game is to open a chest that grants you a pistol.  Not auto equipped.  So you go to your inventory to equip it...not there... Go through the door, meet your first enemy, tutorial says hold LT to aim and RT to fire...but nothing happens.  Immediately die, assuming it is some kind of bug, respawn.  See chest is now empty. Go through door, same tutorial, same result.  Run away...go back to obelisk that simply says  SAVE GAME and telegraphs NOTHING about needing to use it to access your REAL inventory and equip your gun....*(this point here I think the Devs missed because it was not a command function problem obviously)*  This is how you are introduced to this game.  UNFORTUNATE because the graphics are nice, the aesthetic is cool and interesting but if this is how mindnumbingly inconsiderate and short sighted the developers are right out of the gate, I cannot reasonably hope things get better from here.  It looks so cool in the video but the devs are numbskulls *(still kinda think this is true considering their kind response to this review)* and obviously dedicated to this stupidity like a badge of honor for their vapid egos. That is the nicest thing I can say about devs that allow such a HUGE and ridiculous oversight remain uncorrected. *(I feel better now and I can say nicer things..probably)* Clearly they have terrible instincts and everything they produce should probably be avoided.  Seriously. *(Maybe, sometimes, maybe worth a try on sale possibly)* Never have I been so irritated in the first 2 minutes of playing a game. What a stupid thing...  I mean all you have to do is give a prompt that the obelisk also serves as your equipment hub, OR just allow us to actually access our inventory from the INVENTORY BUTTON and equip our weapons.....ffs. *(seems like maybe originally a crafting mechanic was planned then abandoned, i'm assuming you'd find plans for weapons then have to craft them at the obelisk, but somebody dropped the ball on loose ends)* smh  I just want to punch the devs right in the face...*(that's another thing, you can't punch in this game.  No melee ability till you find a melee weapon)* stuff like this is why the Titanic sank... so much amazing potential squandered by probably one vapid incompetent narcissistic project head corporate suit type. *(I'm right, aren't I?)*
*(So anyway, I now will recommend this game on sale if you enjoy Dark Souls-lite, 3rd person (w/ lock on) shooter.  Since the Devs have time to respond to reviews like this...maybe they have time to work on this game a little bit more? Like fixing the bug where your character's walk/run animation stops working and you just slide around....)*
Keep Calm and Kellogg Globalists.  That is all.
reviews.developer_response: Thank you for your review. We are sorry to hear you had a frustrating experience. We looked at the game functions and saw no problem with commands. Click on Options to  tailor functions to your needs. We hope you reconsider playing Immortal a bit further. It has a cool storyline and very challenging. thanks
